changelog:
alibabacloud-agentloop-contextstore 0.0.1

- Initial release of the skill for managing Alibaba Cloud CloudMonitor Service (CMS) AgentLoop ContextStore resources using the aliyun CLI (API version 2024-03-30).
- Supports creating, querying, updating, and deleting memory/experience stores and context records, as well as managing store API keys.
- Provides detailed installation, environment, authentication, and permission requirements.
- Enforces user parameter confirmation and secure handling of credentials.
- Requires enabling AI-mode for CLI workflows and ensures it is disabled at all workflow exits.
